name: Correlation Meter
explanation: A phase/correlation meter with a live goniometer. Correlation is a running coefficient (exponential moving averages of L*R, L^2, R^2): +1 fully correlated (mono-safe), 0 uncorrelated, -1 fully out of phase (will cancel to silence in mono). Goniometer mode plots the standard 45-degree-rotated Mid/Side basis (mono collapses to a vertical line); Lissajous mode plots raw L/R (mono draws a diagonal instead). The meter always analyzes the true, pre-sum stereo signal - Mono Check only changes what you HEAR (sums L+R to both channels) so you can audition mono compatibility while still watching the real stereo relationship causing whatever you hear.
